stemMarkdown: Which of the following sentences is grammatically correct?

options.markdown: The number of applicants has risen sharply this year.
The number of applicants have risen sharply this year.
A number of applicants has risen sharply this year.
The number of applicants are rising sharply this year.

solutionMarkdown: **The number** is singular and takes **has**; confusingly, **a number of** is plural and takes a plural verb. The third option uses the plural phrase with a singular verb and also changes the meaning.
